reason: After thorough review of Hikma Pharmaceuticals PLC's H1 2025 interim results filing, no Total Addressable Market (TAM) figures were disclosed by the company. The document contains detailed financial performance data, segment revenues, regional breakdowns, strategic initiatives, and medium-term guidance (revenue CAGR targets for 2024-2027 and $5B revenue target by 2030), but does not include any company-disclosed TAM estimates for its Injectables, Branded, or Hikma Rx segments, nor for any geographic markets (North America, MENA, Europe). No market sizing data was provided by the company itself.
